# Legal-Finance Audit

## Purpose
Assess the state of the Legal-Finance department in the whole system: how well legal review, contracts, privacy, compliance, cost, and financial hygiene hold together, and where they are weak.

## Scope
- Legal review and contracts
- Privacy and data handling
- Compliance basics
- Cost tracking and spend
- Financial state and runway
- Record of obligations, licenses, and renewal dates

## What is in place
- [ ] Lead agents for legal and finance are named and active
- [ ] Skill that reviews contracts and terms
- [ ] Skill that checks privacy handling
- [ ] Skill that tracks costs and spend
- [ ] Skill that analyses financial state and runway
- [ ] Workflow that reviews new commitments before they are signed
- [ ] Record of contracts, licenses, and obligations in one place

## Gaps
- [ ] Contracts are signed without review
- [ ] Privacy handling is undocumented
- [ ] Costs drift with no regular check
- [ ] Financial state is unclear when a decision needs it
- [ ] Obligations and renewal dates live in scattered notes

## Next steps
- Pick the highest priority gap and name its owner
- Add or fix the missing agent, skill, command, or workflow for that gap
- Run the new piece on a real contract or budget review and check the result against evidence
- Record the decision and the outcome in the decision log
- Repeat for the next gap
- Share the finished audit and the changes with the people who need them, so the work reaches distribution
